summary: Beacon Financial Corp filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing that director John M. Pereira notified the company and its Beacon Bank Trust subsidiary on September 28 that he will resign from both boards effective September 30, 2026. No successor, transition plan, or reason was disclosed, and the filing carries no financial terms or advisor. The board seat vacancy is the sole event; this is a board-level departure rather than an executive officer exit. Watch for a follow-on 8-K naming a replacement and any change to committee composition or strategic posture.
